- Add a tin of chickpeas and a tin of tomatoes, simmer 8 minutes
- Stir through the spinach until wilted

Serve with rice or naan. Want me to add anything you're missing to the shopping list?

Prompt (low): "Drop your shoulders away from your ears and unclench your jaw. Take one slow breath — what shifted, even slightly?"
Reply: honestly my shoulders were basically up around my ears. dropped them and it eased a bit but i'm still tense.

Reply: worst case is i miss thursday and have to explain why the writeup is late, which would be annoying but survivable. i'd just tell my manager early.
